from PIL import Image

arr29 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0029.png').convert('RGB'))

ys, xs = np.where(sofa_m)
print(f'Sofa in obs29: x=[{xs.min()},{xs.max()}], y=[{ys.min()},{ys.max()}], bot={ys.max()}')

# Lamp base:
lamp_m = (arr29[:, :, 0] > 50) & (arr29[:, :, 0] < 120) & (arr29[:, :, 1] > 70) & (arr29[:, :, 1] < 130) & (arr29[:, :, 2] > 80) & (arr29[:, :, 2] < 150) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 200)

print(f'Sofa: d={d_sofa:.3f}, x_world={0.5+d_sofa:.3f}, y_world={2.0-lat_sofa:.3f}')

print(f'Lamp: d={d_lamp:.3f}, x_world={0.5+d_lamp:.3f}, y_world={2.0-lat_lamp:.3f}')
